description: This donut-style pie chart visually represents the categorization of characters into two main groups: “Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters,” with the latter further subdivided. The outer ring, colored light blue, is divided into six segments labeled “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” “Custom Characters,” and “Real Characters.” The inner circle, also light blue, is labeled “Virtual Characters.” The “Real Characters” segment, colored green, is subdivided into smaller slices labeled “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers,” all appearing in varying shades of green. The chart lacks a legend or percentage labels inside the slices, and no segments are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding. The segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order of size from left to right, with “Virtual Characters” occupying the largest portion of the chart.
